subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, among the seven sister states, which state has the highest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mizoram has the highest literacy rate among the seven sister states according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The literacy rate of Mizoram is 91.58% as per the 2011 census data.
 
• This high literacy rate is attributed to the effective educational policies and programs implemented by the state government.
 
• Mizoram's literacy rate is higher than the national average literacy rate of 74.04%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seven Sister States**

 
 
• The Seven Sister States of India comprise Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura.
 
• These states are located in the northeastern region of India and are known for their unique cultures and diverse languages.
 
• They are connected to the rest of India by a narrow corridor called the Siliguri Corridor or Chicken's Neck.
 
 
 
• **Literacy Rate**
 
 
• Literacy rate is the percentage of people who are able to read and write with understanding at a specified age.
 
• It is a crucial indicator of the educational level of a population.
 
• Higher literacy rates are associated with better economic development and improved quality of life.
 
 
 
• **Census of India 2011**
 
 
• The Census of India 2011 is the 15th National Census since 1872.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on the demographics, social, and economic aspects of the Indian population.
 
• Conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
